# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 19 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 19
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. The way of the Black One is twisted and crammed with curses. It is the road of eternal death and punishment, and here is what lives there to destroy souls: idolatry, arrogance, the abuse of power, hypocrisy, a divided heart, adultery, murder, theft, conceit, lawbreaking, deception, malice, stubbornness, sorcery, witchcraft, greed, and the complete absence of the fear of God.
2. This is the way of those who persecute the good and hate truth — who love lies, who have no idea what righteousness earns, who refuse to hold to what is good or to judge fairly, who ignore the widow and the orphan, who keep their eyes open not for the fear of God but for opportunities to do evil. Gentleness and patience have nothing to do with them. They love empty things and chase after payoffs. They have no pity for the poor. They do not lift a hand to help the burdened. They are quick to tear down people with their words. They do not acknowledge who made them. They kill children and destroy what God has shaped. They turn their backs on those in need. They crush those who are already suffering. They speak up for the wealthy and condemn the poor unjustly. They are steeped in sin in every conceivable way.
